clue.text: Killer naturally hated unstable explosive

indicators.note: something unstable will not hold its shape, so these letters fall into a new order

parts.note: a cap is a small explosive charge, as in a cap gun or percussion cap

explanation.surface: A nervous killer hated handling volatile explosives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Killer naturally' is a poisonous fungus: nature's own killer, not a person.
explanation.definitionFit: This mushroom is a natural poison, a killer grown by nature rather than made by people.

clue.text: Stallone to conceal his 72 years as wise man?

indicators.note: concealing something means holding it inside, so one piece wraps the other

parts.note: Sylvester Stallone is widely nicknamed Sly
a number of years lived is one's age

explanation.surface: An ageing film star hides his years, perhaps acting the wise old man.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb describes acting with wisdom, the way a sage or wise elder would behave.

clue.text: Expressed clearly for Greek character on preceding day

parts.note: mu is a letter of the Greek alphabet
late can mean former or previous, as in 'the late chairman'

explanation.surface: A statement made clearly about a Greek figure the day before.
explanation.definitionFit: To put an idea into precise, carefully composed words is to state it clearly.

clue.text: Composer changes not one note

indicators.note: not having something means it is left out

parts.note: varies means changes
I is the Roman numeral for one
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: A composer revises his work, leaving out a single note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not one' drops I from VARIES, leaving VARES. Edgard Varèse was a French-born modernist composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Edgard Varèse was a twentieth-century French-American modernist who wrote music such as Ionisation.

clue.text: Remove fat when dividing amount

indicators.note: a piece dividing another splits it in two by sitting inside it

parts.note: a degree is an amount or extent, as in 'to some degree'
as can mean when, as in 'as he left'

explanation.surface: Advice on trimming fat when portioning out a quantity of meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Cleaning grease off something, such as an engine part or oven, takes away its fat.

clue.text: Dessert has whiskey with it

parts.note: W is whiskey in the NATO phonetic alphabet
hip means fashionable, with it

explanation.surface: A pudding served with a splash of whiskey.
explanation.definitionFit: A whip is a light pudding made with whipped cream or egg whites.

clue.text: Spurious blues tune almost without nuance

indicators.note: something spurious is false or not genuine, so these letters are faked into a new order
almost means not quite all, so the final letter goes

explanation.surface: A fake blues number that is rather heavy-handed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims TUNE to TUN; 'Spurious' scrambles BLUES with TUN.
explanation.definitionFit: Something lacking subtlety or fine shading is crude and obvious, with no nuance.

clue.text: See 13
Give address on back cover and melt away

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece on another follows it
back means read the other way round

parts.note: to pave a surface is to cover it
to orate is to deliver an address or speech

explanation.surface: Someone gives an address on the back of an envelope and then vanishes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' reverses PAVE to EVAP, and ORATE goes 'on' it.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquid that evaporates disappears into vapour, so the word also means to fade or vanish.

clue.text: Believer pulled from filth in dungeon

indicators.note: the letters are drawn out of the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A man of faith is dragged out of a filthy dungeon.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of Hinduism is a religious believer.

clue.text: Heating unit in the space vacated

indicators.note: a vacated word has its inside emptied, leaving only its outer letters

parts.note: room means space

explanation.surface: A heater sits in an empty room.
explanation.definitionFit: A therm is a measure of heat energy, used in Britain for billing gas.

clue.text: Poet's last letter in time associated with pen

definitions.note: read as 'poet is', so the definition is the poet

indicators.note: in places one piece inside another

parts.note: an era is a period of time
Z is the last letter of the alphabet
a pound is an enclosure or pen for animals

explanation.surface: A poet's final letter, written while in a prison pen.
explanation.definitionFit: Ezra Pound was the American modernist poet behind The Cantos.

clue.text: Loudly accuse Mrs Peacock?

parts.note: in the board game Cluedo; the idiom means to protest loudly

explanation.surface: A Cluedo player shouts out an accusation against Mrs Peacock.
explanation.walkthrough: Mrs Peacock is the blue piece in Cluedo, the murder-mystery board game, so shouting that she did it is literally the idiom.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to complain or protest very loudly, here read literally as shouting an accusation.

clue.text: Plug connecting to a different port?

definitions.text: Plug connecting to a different port?

indicators.note: connecting to joins one piece onto the next

parts.note: a plug is an advertisement, an ad

indicators.note: different means changed, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A device lets a plug fit a socket of another kind.
explanation.definitionFit: This device lets a plug fit a socket or connector of another type.

clue.text: American demanding expenses whatever happens

parts.note: tall means demanding, as in 'a tall order'
costs means expenses

explanation.surface: An American insists on expenses no matter what.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means regardless of the price or consequences, in any event.

clue.text: Fold encompassing grassy area in part

indicators.note: encompassing means surrounding, so one piece goes around the other

parts.note: a lea is a meadow

explanation.surface: A sheep fold takes in a stretch of grassland.
explanation.definitionFit: A pleat is a crease or fold sewn into cloth.

clue.text: See 18
Reward band name hated report may suggest?

parts.note: these words mixed up give the band name's first two words, and its last word says they burst apart

explanation.surface: A band's name is suggested by a hostile review.
explanation.walkthrough: Reward was a 1981 hit for this Liverpool band. Read as wordplay, the name tells you to scramble the letters of the clue's 'hated report'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Teardrop Explodes were the Liverpool group whose best-known single was Reward.

clue.text: Wherein planes perhaps reach their ceiling?

definitions.text: Wherein planes perhaps reach their ceiling?

parts.words: Wherein planes perhaps reach their ceiling?
parts.note: planes are trees as well as aircraft, and a tree's highest growth is at its crown

explanation.surface: Where aircraft climb to their maximum height.
explanation.walkthrough: Planes here are plane trees, not aircraft, and their ceiling is the highest point they grow to.
explanation.definitionFit: The topmost branches of trees are where a plane tree reaches its greatest height.

clue.text: Books to get on earlier vehicle

indicators.note: earlier places this piece before the other

parts.note: to get on in years is to age
NT is the New Testament, a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: Someone books a ticket to board an earlier coach.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words can mean a means or medium by which something is achieved.

clue.text: See 18
Nick wants height advantage

parts.note: the top is the highest point
an edge is an advantage

explanation.surface: A man called Nick wants to gain a taller person's advantage.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a nick is a thin touch of the ball off the bat's edge; a top edge comes off the upper edge.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket both terms describe the ball glancing off the edge of the bat.

clue.text: Thus far the lonely heart's desire?

definitions.meaning: someone placing a lonely hearts ad hopes to arrange a romantic outing

explanation.surface: So far, the single person is still wishing.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means up until now, and also reads as wanting to go on a romantic outing.

clue.text: Volcanic crater about to swallow tree

indicators.note: swallowing something takes it inside, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: CA (circa) means about
the alder is a tree

explanation.surface: A volcano's crater is on the verge of engulfing a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A caldera is a large basin formed when a volcano collapses after eruption.

clue.text: Way to cook cabbage catches on

indicators.note: catching something takes hold of it inside, so one piece contains the other

parts.note: cole is an old word for cabbage, as in coleslaw
re means on or about, concerning

explanation.surface: A method of cooking cabbage is becoming popular.
explanation.definitionFit: Creole cuisine is a style of cooking from Louisiana and the Caribbean.

clue.text: Book flight

definitions.meaning: the second book of the Old Testament
a mass departure or fleeing of people

explanation.definitionFit: It is the second book of the Bible and also a mass departure of people fleeing.

clue.text: Dustman idle outside Job Centre?

indicators.note: outside means one piece wraps around the other

parts.note: an idle person does little

indicators.note: the centre of a word is its middle letter

explanation.surface: An unemployed bin man loiters outside the Job Centre.
explanation.walkthrough: Alfred Doolittle is Eliza's dustman father in Shaw's Pygmalion. 'Job Centre' looks like the UK benefits office but gives the middle letter O.
explanation.definitionFit: Alfred Doolittle, Eliza's father in Pygmalion and My Fair Lady, collects rubbish for a living.

clue.text: First nine letters sent north — the ninth from Greeks

indicators.note: in a down clue going north means read upwards, the other way

parts.note: the first nine letters of the alphabet run A to I

explanation.surface: A letter-writer sends nine letters north, the ninth arriving from Greece.
explanation.walkthrough: A TO I written upwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Iota is the ninth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Starter of duck becoming duck and egg?

indicators.note: the starter is the first letter of the word
becoming means changing into, so one letter is swapped for another

parts.note: to duck is to avoid
a duck is a score of nothing, O

explanation.surface: A duckling's first step turns it into a duck and an egg.
explanation.walkthrough: AVOID has its first letter A replaced by O.
explanation.definitionFit: Ovoid means egg-shaped, and as a noun names an egg-shaped body.

clue.text: Nurse removes husband from danger

indicators.note: removing something takes it out of the word

parts.note: a threat is a danger

explanation.surface: A nurse saves a man from a perilous situation.
explanation.definitionFit: To nurse a patient is to give medical care, which is what treating them means.

clue.text: Drunk bowled in to serve old committee

indicators.note: in places these pieces inside the other

parts.note: to pour drinks is to serve them
lit is slang for drunk
B is the cricket abbreviation for bowled

explanation.surface: A drunk is bowled in to serve on an old committee.
explanation.definitionFit: The Politburo was the chief policy-making committee of the Soviet Communist Party.
